four_hq_bound_attacks.A_route_pass_applicability: MATERIAL DEFECT — a non-route source with outer exact 0 either cannot execute at all (maximum=0 -> ROUTE_PASS_LIMIT_REACHED before any operation) or executes and then fails the outer check after the source was already accessed (expected=0, no maximum). Cause: execute() increments the outer pass counter for EVERY successful run regardless of mode.
four_hq_bound_attacks.B_failed_attempt_retry_zero: MATERIAL DEFECT — a transiently failing first attempt followed by a successful second attempt performed TWO source operations (2 existence checks, 2 decoder entries) while the retries account stayed 0. No retry gate exists; the only pre-operation gate keys on COMPLETED passes, so a failed attempt leaves it open.
four_hq_bound_attacks.C_completion_semantics: MATERIAL DEFECT — _passes_completed increments BEFORE post-operation constraint checks, so a pass is counted even when the bound postcondition fails, including when the outer EXACT check itself fails. Operation-return is being conflated with completed governed pass.
four_hq_bound_attacks.D_dependency_injection: MATERIAL DEFECT — BoundSourceExecution accepts pyreadstat_module and never stores or forwards it; _ensure_session hard-codes pyreadstat_module=None. The supplied module is silently discarded and the ambient import always used. Affects the binding layer's ability to assert and demonstrate bound reader identity, not merely testability.
